name: Verifed V29
description: Implements the approved Warm Forest CAC mobile redesign across Home, Explore, Journal and the separated floating navigation: darker forest content sections, muted cream background, orange standalone plus action, a problem-solution hero, properly branded carrot-check Verifed header, complete-photo restaurant menus and real Journal summary metrics.
notes: Restored distinct Taco Bell purple and Chipotle brown/red restaurant styling without changing restaurant product menus.
Only the five complete-photo demonstration menus are prioritized, with Taco Bell, Loving Hut Orlando and Hawkers Orlando first; filters and branch selection remain in effect.
Home's hero describes dietary communication as an aid, not a claim of certified allergen safety; featured cards use real bundled food images.
Journal average, place count and meal count are computed from the actual saved entries. Empty accounts display no fabricated ratings.
Added V29 tests for brand isolation, real-data labels, featured ordering and the separated floating plus control.
GitHub Actions must validate the mobile tests and platform bundles before saving the Expo Snack snapshot. Physical-device screen testing is still required.
